name: Ambient garden — other + contract
description: S2/S9: genre-less ambient must declare a playtest contract and may use canvas2d honestly (no decoy Phaser).
brief: You are the tide. Guide paper boats home by dragging currents. Soft ambient toy, no fail state. Declare a playtest contract that asserts progress rises when the pointer moves. Prefer canvas2d if Phaser/Three would be a fake.
